# Avatar

An image or initials with a size and optional status mark.

## Props

| Prop | Requirement | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | Optional | string or object | A remote URL or Plugin asset served through the Server. |
| `initials` | Optional | string | Fallback initials. |
| `size` | Optional | `sm`, `md`, `lg` | Avatar size. |
| `status` | Optional | string | Optional status mark. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | Optional | string | The visible and accessible label. |

## Accessibility

- **Accessible name:** `accessibilityLabel` when supplied.
- **Keyboard:** Avatar is not keyboard-focusable on its own; a containing control supplies the focus stop.
- **VoiceOver:** VoiceOver exposes the Avatar as an image and reads accessibilityLabel, or the initials when no label is supplied.
- **TalkBack:** TalkBack exposes the Avatar as an image and reads accessibilityLabel, or the initials when no label is supplied.
